ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.

19. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

20. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
